verdict.rationale: Vanta documents an integrations catalog that connects cloud infrastructure, version control, identity providers and productivity tools, naming AWS (40+ resources), Azure, Okta and GitHub. That covers the core of connecting a real stack. MDM appears only as a category for building custom integrations through the Vanta API, not as a catalog connector, so it earns no credit here. Nothing in the pack shows HR or ticketing connectors, or that integrations use read-only scopes. missing for 10: HR integrations, ticketing integrations, native MDM catalog connectors, documentation of read-only permission scopes, independent or hands-on corroboration.
